world.title: Supreme Court allows Trump administration to use controversial voter citizenship database before midterms
world.summary: The US Supreme Court has permitted the Trump administration to utilize a contentious federal database for states to verify the citizenship status of registered voters ahead of the midterm elections. This decision supports Trump's efforts to enhance voter citizenship checks, although it maintains a prohibition on mass voter purges. The ruling has significant implications for upcoming electoral processes.

world.title: 14 killed in Congo plane crash, two senior military officials among dead
world.summary: Fourteen people died in a plane crash in Congo while returning to Kinshasa from Kikwit. The incident involved two senior military officials among the victims. Authorities confirmed the fatalities, highlighting the tragic loss of life. The crash has raised concerns regarding aviation safety in the region, prompting investigations into the circumstances surrounding the accident.

world.title: ‘This is the autopen’: Trump mocks Biden while showing Xi presidential portraits
world.summary: During Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to the White House, former President Donald Trump mocked Joe Biden while showing portraits of Xi. Trump pointed to an image of an autopen that replicates Biden's signature, jokingly referring to it as "the autopen." The event took place at the "Presidential Walk of Fame" in the White House's Colonnade.

business.title: India’s Rs 1.27 lakh cr chip push needs more than fabs. 2 stocks supplying the missing pieces
business.summary: India's ₹1.27 lakh crore semiconductor initiative is fostering opportunities in materials and components, addressing the country's reliance on imports. The focus is on chip design, advanced packaging, semiconductor equipment, and essential materials. Two engineering companies are positioning themselves to capitalize on this shift in the semiconductor supply chain, aiming to enhance domestic production capabilities and reduce import dependency.

business.title: EPFO curbs for early retirees: 12-month wait for full EPF withdrawal
business.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has announced a 12-month waiting period for members retiring or quitting before age 55 to access their full EPF balance. This decision, made by the Central Board of Trustees, allows members to withdraw 75% of their balance immediately. The notification was issued on June 29, 2026, outlining these new regulations.

business.title: 5 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of up to 28% in 1 year, according to analysts
business.summary: Analysts have identified five stocks with consistent score improvements and potential upside of up to 28% within a year. Despite weekend market closures, global events can impact trading. Investors are advised to remain cautious as market fluctuations are normal and temporary, rather than indicative of a significant change in market conditions. Caution is recommended during these periods.

technology.title: Is GTA 6 worth the hype after 13 years? Fans prepare for release amidst high expectations
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to release on November 19, 2026, concluding years of speculation. Pre-orders for the Standard and Ultimate Editions began on June 25, 2026. The game features a new narrative with characters Jason and Lucia, set in a vibrant Miami backdrop. Fans are eagerly anticipating the game amidst high expectations following a 13-year wait.

technology.title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
technology.summary: Google has introduced Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar, enhancing its enterprise AI agents with video personas. This update allows for near real-time visual interaction, integrating native dialogue and low-latency streaming video. The feature supports background tool calls and operates in 97 languages, aiming to improve user engagement and communication in enterprise settings. Gemini Enterprise users can access it now.

technology.title: Review: The iPhone 18 Pro is Apple's coolest smartphone (but only literally)
technology.summary: The iPhone 18 Pro features improved thermals and battery life, enhancing user experience. This model represents an iterative update in Apple's smartphone lineup, showcasing advancements in performance and efficiency. As Apple transitions from the Tim Cook era, the device reflects ongoing experimentation in design and functionality. The enhancements contribute to a more enjoyable and practical smartphone experience for users.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026 Live Updates, Day 8: India's Sawan Barwal wins silver in marathon; shooters in women's 50m rifle 3P qualification; Lakshya Sen fights back in badminton
sports.summary: On Day 8 of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026, India’s Sawan Barwal secured a silver medal in the marathon. Indian shooters participated in the women's 50m rifle 3P qualification event. Additionally, badminton player Lakshya Sen made a strong comeback in his match. The event continues to provide updates on medal tallies, results, and schedules.

sports.title: Italy crisis deepens as Belgium’s win stalls World Cup rebuild in Rome
sports.summary: Italy's football crisis worsened as they lost 2-0 to Belgium in their Nations League opener at a nearly empty Stadio Olimpico. This defeat marks Italy's continued struggles following their failure to qualify for the World Cup for the third consecutive time. The match highlighted ongoing issues within the team as they seek to rebuild their competitive stature.

sports.title: The Ballon d’Or case for Lamine Yamal: When brilliance goes beyond numbers and records
sports.summary: Lamine Yamal, at 19, is making headlines for his exceptional performance in football, breaking records typically associated with older players. While discussions often focus on his youth, Barcelona argues that his skill and impact on the game are the strongest reasons for considering him a candidate for the 2026 Ballon d'Or, transcending mere statistics and age-related context.

health.title: Ebola epidemic update - Cases and deaths
health.summary: Seventy new confirmed cases of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) were reported in the last 24 hours, including 11 community deaths. The provinces of Ituri and North Kivu each recorded 31 cases, while Haut-Uélé reported 6 cases, and Bas-Uélé had 1 case. The ongoing epidemic continues to raise concerns in affected regions as health authorities respond to the outbreak.

health.title: Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus - Democratic Republic of the Congo
health.summary: The Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded, affecting two new health zones, bringing the total to 63 across seven provinces. As of 23 September 2026, there are 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths, with a case fatality ratio of 48.1%. High daily case numbers persist, complicating timely detection and patient care.

science.title: NASA continues development of PRIMA infrared telescope
science.summary: NASA has advanced the PRIMA infrared telescope mission to Phase B, focusing on preliminary design and technology development. The spacecraft, intended for far-infrared observations, is projected to launch no earlier than 2033 and is expected to operate for five years. This development marks a significant step in NASA's ongoing efforts to enhance astronomical observation capabilities.

science.title: $30 million rescue op fails: Spacecraft sent to save Nasa telescope falls back to Earth
science.summary: A private spacecraft intended to rescue NASA's aging Swift Observatory has fallen back to Earth due to technical failures, ending the mission. The $30 million operation aimed to extend the telescope's life, but the setbacks have left it with only weeks of operational capability. The Swift Observatory has been instrumental in astronomical research since its launch.

science.title: Canadian Astronaut Joshua Kutryk Will Carry His Ukrainian Great-Grandfather’s Watch to the ISS
science.summary: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk, of Ukrainian descent, will carry his great-grandfather's pocket watch to the International Space Station during his six-month mission starting October 1. He will be accompanied by American astronaut Jessica Watkins and Russian cosmonaut Sergey Kud-Sverchkov. Kutryk's gesture honors his heritage and connects him to his family's history as he embarks on this journey.

entertainment.title: 9/25/26 (United States Championship Steel Cage Match, Money in the Bank Qualifying Matches)
entertainment.summary: WWE SmackDown on September 25, 2026, took place at Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, Indiana, featuring commentary by Michael Cole and Corey Graves. The event included a United States Championship Steel Cage Match and several Money in the Bank qualifying matches. Results were reported by Mike Tedesco of Wrestleview.com, highlighting key moments and outcomes from the evening's matches.

entertainment.title: Sagittarius Horoscope Today: September 26, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 26, 2026, Sagittarius individuals may experience anxiety regarding finances or existential issues, prompting a search for opportunities and resources to enhance security. The Full Moon serves as a reminder to reflect on these concerns, encouraging a balance between striving for stability and recognizing the importance of inner peace. Embrace the moment and consider your priorities carefully.

entertainment.title: Capricorn Horoscope Today: September 26, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 26, 2026, Capricorn individuals are encouraged to reflect on their tendency to hold on tightly to situations or emotions. The Full Moon prompts a reconsideration of this behavior, suggesting that letting go may not result in loss. It may be beneficial to recognize that clinging could be a habit rather than a necessity, inviting change and growth.
